svg.title: Wheelprints — Drift
svg.desc: A woven orbit built from nested sculptural contours. Accepted work per round controls contour density and the width or curl of the form. Completed Squeek blocks control the number of lobes, turns, or oscillations. Replay reveals the drawing construction. It does not reconstruct physical wheel movement.
